stories.title: La Audiencia Nacional condena a 17 años de cárcel a Sito Miñanco y absuelve al abogado Gonzalo Boye del delito de blanqueo

en.title: The National Court sentences Sito Miñanco to 17 years in prison and acquits lawyer Gonzalo Boye of money laundering charges
en.summary: A Spanish court found that a Galician drug trafficker led an operation to smuggle nearly four tons of cocaine into Europe in 2017, resulting in a 17-year prison sentence, while acquitting his lawyer of related money laundering allegations.

stories.title: El Supremo confirma 4 años de cárcel para el futbolista Santi Mina por abuso sexual

en.title: The Supreme Court confirms 4 years in prison for footballer Santi Mina for sexual abuse
en.summary: Spain's Supreme Court upheld a four-year prison sentence against a footballer convicted of sexually abusing a woman in a van near a nightclub in Almería in July 2017.

stories.title: El Tribunal Supremo ratifica la condena de cuatro años de prisión a Santi Mina por abusar sexualmente de una mujer en Mojácar

en.title: The Supreme Court upholds the four-year prison sentence for Santi Mina for sexually abusing a woman in Mojácar
en.summary: Spain's highest court confirmed a four-year prison sentence against the former Valencia and Celta player for sexually abusing a woman, rejecting his claims of misinterpreting her actions.

stories.title: Zapatero dice al juez que las joyas son «un obsequio» que el rey de Arabia Saudí le entregó en 2007

en.title: Zapatero tells judge that jewels are a "gift" given to him by the Saudi Arabian king in 2007
en.summary: Former Spanish Prime Minister José Luis Rodríguez Zapatero claimed in court that jewels valued at 1.3 million euros found in his office were a gift from Saudi Arabia's king in 2007, in response to an investigation into a Plus Ultra bailout.

stories.title: El Supremo confirma la condena de 4 años de cárcel para Santi Mina por abuso sexual

en.title: Supreme Court confirms 4-year prison sentence for Santi Mina for sexual abuse
en.summary: Spain's Supreme Court upheld a four-year prison conviction against footballer Santi Mina for sexual abuse. The incident allegedly occurred in July 2017 near a nightclub in Mojácar.

stories.title: El Supremo confirma cuatro años de cárcel para el futbolista Santi Mina por abuso sexual a una mujer

en.title: Supreme Court confirms four years in prison for footballer Santi Mina for sexual abuse of a woman
en.summary: Spain's Supreme Court rejected the acquittal of footballer Santi Mina, upholding a four-year sentence for sexual abuse. The court determined he committed two non-consensual sexual acts in 2017.

stories.title: La Audiencia Nacional absuelve al abogado de Carles Puigdemont de blanquear para 'Sito Miñanco', condenado a 17 años de cárcel

en.title: National Court acquits Carles Puigdemont's lawyer of money laundering for 'Sito Miñanco', sentenced to 17 years in prison
en.summary: The National Court acquitted lawyer Gonzalo Boye of money laundering charges. The Anti-Drug Prosecution had sought nine years and nine months imprisonment for Boye over allegations of falsifying documents related to 900,000 euros seized at Barajas.

stories.title: La Audiencia Nacional condena a Sito Miñanco a 17 años de cárcel por la operación Mito y absuelve a Boye

en.title: National Court sentences Sito Miñanco to 17 years in prison for Operation Mito and acquits Boye
en.summary: Spain's National Court sentenced drug trafficker José Ramón Prado Bugallo, known as 'Sito Miñanco', to 17 years in prison for Operation Mito, involving a cocaine trafficking operation in 2017. The court acquitted lawyer Gonzalo Boye of money laundering and document falsification charges.

stories.title: Zapatero sostiene que Arabia Saudí le regaló las joyas en 2007 y pide al juez que oficie una comisión rogatoria

en.title: Zapatero claims Saudi Arabia gifted him jewelry in 2007 and asks judge to issue letters rogatory
en.summary: The former Spanish president states that jewelry seized by authorities was a personal gift from Saudi Arabia and requests judicial assistance to verify this claim.

stories.title: La Audiencia Nacional absuelve a Gonzalo Boye de blanqueo en el caso del narco Sito Miñanco

en.title: National Court acquits Gonzalo Boye of money laundering in Sito Miñanco drug case
en.summary: The lawyer representing former Catalan president Carles Puigdemont has been cleared of charges related to money laundering and document falsification.

stories.title: Estas son las 12 joyas que Zapatero señala como un regalo del Rey saudí en 2007

en.title: These are the 12 jewels that Zapatero identifies as a gift from the Saudi King in 2007
en.summary: The former president's legal defense contests the valuation of seized jewelry pieces, arguing they are not worth the 1.2 million euros estimated by an auction house.

stories.title: Zapatero alega ante el juez que las joyas proceden de un regalo de Arabia Saudí

en.title: Zapatero argues before the judge that the jewels come from a Saudi Arabia gift
en.summary: The former president clarifies that jewelry was delivered in Madrid and states he accepted the gift out of deference and respect for King Abdullah Bin Abdulaziz Al-Saud.

stories.title: Atresmedia repartirá un dividendo de 187 millones tras la desinversión en Fever

en.title: Atresmedia will distribute a dividend of 187 million after divesting from Fever
en.summary: Atresmedia sold its remaining 5% stake in entertainment platform Fever for about 227 million euros, enabling the company to pay out a 187 million euro dividend.

stories.title: Grenergy se desploma un 13,5% y Solaria un 5,9% por el plan del Gobierno para contener los precios de la energía

en.title: Grenergy falls 13.5% and Solaria 5.9% over Government plan to contain energy prices
en.summary: Shares of energy companies Grenergy and Solaria declined after the Government announced plans to approve measures controlling energy-driven inflation stemming from Middle East tensions.

stories.title: Volotea ultima una reestructuración completa tras sufrir un impacto de 150 millones por Irán

en.title: Volotea completes comprehensive restructuring after suffering 150 million impact from Iran
en.summary: Volotea is executing a complete restructuring following a 150 million euro impact, involving debt renegotiation, capital increase, capacity reduction exceeding 20%, and job cuts in Barcelona.

stories.title: El petróleo y la deuda vuelven a llevarse los 19.700 puntos del Ibex

en.title: Oil and debt pull down Ibex at 19,700 points
en.summary: The Ibex 35 index opens lower as Brent crude prices fall to just over 98 dollars amid expectations of increased Saudi supply.

stories.title: Colonial SFL entra en residencias de estudiantes de la mano de Vita

en.title: Colonial SFL enters student housing market with Vita
en.summary: Colonial SFL and British group Vita have formed a joint venture to operate student residences, beginning operations with three properties located in Madrid.
